    42  /*
    43   * OpenFlow 1.3 modifies the syntax of the following message types:
    44   *
    45   * OFPT_FEATURES_REPLY     = 6    (opf13_switch_features)
    46   *                                 - new field: auxiliary_id
    47   *                                 - removed: ofp_ports at the end
    48   *
    49   * OFPT_PACKET_IN          = 10   (appends an ovs_be64 to ofp12_packet_in)
    50   *
    51   * OpenFlow 1.3 adds following new message types:
    52   *
    53   * * Asynchronous message configuration. *
    54   * OFPT13_GET_ASYNC_REQUEST  = 26   (void)
    55   * OFPT13_GET_ASYNC_REPLY    = 27   (ofp13_async_config)
    56   * OFPT13_SET_ASYNC          = 28   (ofp13_async_config)
    57   *
    58   * * Meters and rate limiters configuration messages. *
    59   * OFPT13_METER_MOD          = 29   (ofp13_meter_mod)
    60   *
    61   * OpenFlow 1.3 modifies the syntax of the following statistics message types
    62   * (now called multipart message types):
    63   *
    64   * OFPMP13_FLOW_REPLY = 1 (struct ofp13_flow_stats[])
    65   * OFPMP13_TABLE_REPLY = 3 (struct ofp13_table_stats[])
    66   * OFPMP13_PORT_REPLY = 4 (struct ofp13_port_stats[])
    67   * OFPMP13_QUEUE_REPLY = 5, (struct ofp13_queue_stats[])
    68   * OFPMP13_GROUP_REPLY = 6, (struct ofp13_group_stats[])
    69   *
    70   * OpenFlow 1.3 adds the following multipart message types
    71   *
    72   * Meter statistics:
    73   * OFPMP13_METER_REQUEST = 9, (struct ofp13_meter_multipart_request)
    74   * OFPMP13_METER_REPLY = 9, (struct ofp13_meter_stats[])
    75   *
    76   * Meter configuration:
    77   * OFPMP13_METER_CONFIG_REQUEST = 10, (struct ofp13_meter_multipart_request)
    78   * OFPMP13_METER_CONFIG_REPLY = 10, (struct ofp13_meter_config[])
    79   *
    80   * Meter features:
    81   * OFPMP13_METER_FEATURES_REQUEST = 11 (void)
    82   * OFPMP13_METER_FEATURES_REPLY = 11 (struct ofp13_meter_features)
    83   *
    84   * Table features:
    85   * OFPMP13_TABLE_FEATURES_REQUEST = 12, (struct ofp13_table_features[])
    86   * OFPMP13_TABLE_FEATURES_REPLY = 12, (struct ofp13_table_features[])
    87   *
    88   */

    91      OFPIT13_METER = 6           /* Apply meter (rate limiter) */
    92  };

    94  /* Instruction structure for OFPIT_METER */

    96      ovs_be16 type;              /* OFPIT13_METER */
    97      ovs_be16 len;               /* Length is 8. */
    98      ovs_be32 meter_id;          /* Meter instance. */
    99  };
   100  OFP_ASSERT(sizeof(struct ofp13_instruction_meter) == 8);

   102  /* enum ofp_config_flags value OFPC_INVALID_TTL_TO_CONTROLLER
   103   * is deprecated in OpenFlow 1.3 */

   106  enum ofp13_table_config {
   107      OFPTC13_DEPRECATED_MASK = 3  /* Deprecated bits */
   108  };

   110  /* OpenFlow 1.3 specific flags for flow_mod messages. */

   112      OFPFF13_NO_PKT_COUNTS = 1 << 3, /* Don't keep track of packet count. */
   113      OFPFF13_NO_BYT_COUNTS = 1 << 4  /* Don't keep track of byte count. */

   122  };

    37  #ifndef OPENFLOW_14_H
    38  #define OPENFLOW_14_H 1
    39
    40  #include <openflow/openflow-1.3.h>
    41
    42  /* OpenFlow 1.4.1+ specific capabilities
    43   * (struct ofp_switch_features, member capabilities). */
    44  enum ofp14_capabilities {
    45      OFPC14_BUNDLES        = 1 << 9,    /* Switch supports bundles. */
    46      OFPC14_FLOW_MONITORING = 1 << 10,  /* Switch supports flow monitoring. */
    47  };
    48
    49  /* ## ---------- ## */
    50  /* ## ofp14_port ## */
    51  /* ## ---------- ## */
    52
    53  /* Port description property types. */
    54  enum ofp_port_desc_prop_type {
    55      OFPPDPT14_ETHERNET          = 0,      /* Ethernet property. */
    56      OFPPDPT14_OPTICAL           = 1,      /* Optical property. */
    57      OFPPDPT14_EXPERIMENTER      = 0xFFFF, /* Experimenter property. */
    58  };
    59
    60  /* Ethernet port description property. */
    61  struct ofp14_port_desc_prop_ethernet {
    62      ovs_be16         type;    /* OFPPDPT14_ETHERNET. */
    63      ovs_be16         length;  /* Length in bytes of this property. */
    64      uint8_t          pad[4];  /* Align to 64 bits. */
    65      /* Bitmaps of OFPPF_* that describe features.  All bits zeroed if
    66       * unsupported or unavailable. */
    67      ovs_be32 curr;          /* Current features. */
    68      ovs_be32 advertised;    /* Features being advertised by the port. */
    69      ovs_be32 supported;     /* Features supported by the port. */
    70      ovs_be32 peer;          /* Features advertised by peer. */
    71
    72      ovs_be32 curr_speed;    /* Current port bitrate in kbps. */
    73      ovs_be32 max_speed;     /* Max port bitrate in kbps */
    74  };
    75  OFP_ASSERT(sizeof(struct ofp14_port_desc_prop_ethernet) == 32);
    76
    77  struct ofp14_port {
    78      ovs_be32 port_no;
    79      ovs_be16 length;
    80      uint8_t pad[2];
    81      struct eth_addr hw_addr;
    82      uint8_t pad2[2];                  /* Align to 64 bits. */
    83      char name[OFP10_MAX_PORT_NAME_LEN]; /* Null-terminated */
    84
    85      ovs_be32 config;        /* Bitmap of OFPPC_* flags. */
    86      ovs_be32 state;         /* Bitmap of OFPPS_* flags. */
    87
    88      /* Followed by 0 or more OFPPDPT14_* properties. */
    89  };
    90  OFP_ASSERT(sizeof(struct ofp14_port) == 40);
    91
    92
    93  /* ## -------------- ## */
    94  /* ## ofp14_port_mod ## */
    95  /* ## -------------- ## */
    96
    97  enum ofp14_port_mod_prop_type {
    98      OFPPMPT14_ETHERNET          = 0,      /* Ethernet property. */
    99      OFPPMPT14_OPTICAL           = 1,      /* Optical property. */
   100      OFPPMPT14_EXPERIMENTER      = 0xFFFF, /* Experimenter property. */
   101  };
   102
   103  struct ofp14_port_mod {
   104      ovs_be32 port_no;
   105      uint8_t pad[4];
   106      struct eth_addr hw_addr;
   107      uint8_t pad2[2];
   108      ovs_be32 config;        /* Bitmap of OFPPC_* flags. */
   109      ovs_be32 mask;          /* Bitmap of OFPPC_* flags to be changed. */
   110      /* Followed by 0 or more OFPPMPT14_* properties. */
   111  };
   112  OFP_ASSERT(sizeof(struct ofp14_port_mod) == 24);
   113
   114  /* ## --------------- ## */
   115  /* ## ofp14_table_mod ## */
   116  /* ## --------------- ## */
   117
   118  enum ofp14_table_mod_prop_type {
   119      OFPTMPT14_EVICTION               = 0x2,    /* Eviction property. */
   120      OFPTMPT14_VACANCY                = 0x3,    /* Vacancy property. */
    60          extern int (*build_assert(void))[ sizeof(struct {               \
    61                      unsigned int build_assert_failed : (EXPR) ? 1 : -1; })]
    62  #elif __cplusplus >= 201103L
    63  #define OFP_ASSERT(EXPR) static_assert(EXPR, "assertion failed")
    64  #else  /* __cplusplus < 201103L */
    65  #include <boost/static_assert.hpp>
    66  #define OFP_ASSERT BOOST_STATIC_ASSERT
    67  #endif /* __cplusplus < 201103L */
    68
    69  /* Version number:
    70   * Non-experimental versions released: 0x01 0x02
    71   * Experimental versions released: 0x81 -- 0x99
    72   */
    73  /* The most significant bit being set in the version field indicates an
    74   * experimental OpenFlow version.
    75   */
    76  enum ofp_version {
    77      OFP10_VERSION = 0x01,
    78      OFP11_VERSION = 0x02,
    79      OFP12_VERSION = 0x03,
    80      OFP13_VERSION = 0x04,
    81      OFP14_VERSION = 0x05,
    82      OFP15_VERSION = 0x06,
    83      OFP16_VERSION = 0x07
    84  };
    85
    86  /* Vendor (aka experimenter) IDs.
    87   *
    88   * These are used in various places in OpenFlow to identify an extension
    89   * defined by some vendor, as opposed to a standardized part of the core
    90   * OpenFlow protocol.
    91   *
    92   * Vendor IDs whose top 8 bits are 0 hold an Ethernet OUI in their low 24 bits.
    93   * The Open Networking Foundation assigns vendor IDs whose top 8 bits are
    94   * nonzero.
    95   *
    96   * A few vendor IDs are special:
    97   *
    98   *    - OF_VENDOR_ID is not a real vendor ID and does not appear in the
    99   *      OpenFlow protocol itself.  It can occasionally be useful within Open
   100   *      vSwitch to identify a standardized part of OpenFlow.
   101   *
   102   *    - ONF_VENDOR_ID is being used within the ONF "extensibility" working
   103   *      group to identify extensions being proposed for standardization.
   104   *
   105   * The list is sorted numerically.
   106   */
   107  #define OF_VENDOR_ID    0
   108  #define HPL_VENDOR_ID   0x000004EA /* HP Labs. */
   109  #define NTR_VENDOR_ID   0x0000154d /* Netronome. */
   110  #define NTR_COMPAT_VENDOR_ID   0x00001540 /* Incorrect value used in v2.4. */
   111  #define NX_VENDOR_ID    0x00002320 /* Nicira. */
   112  #define ONF_VENDOR_ID   0x4f4e4600 /* Open Networking Foundation. */
   113  #define INTEL_VENDOR_ID 0x0000AA01 /* Intel */
   114
   115  #define OFP_MAX_TABLE_NAME_LEN 32
   116
   117  #define OFP_OLD_PORT  6633
   118  #define OFP_PORT  6653
   119
   120  #define OFP_DEFAULT_MISS_SEND_LEN   128
   121
   122  /* Values below this cutoff are 802.3 packets and the two bytes
   123   * following MAC addresses are used as a frame length.  Otherwise, the
   124   * two bytes are used as the Ethernet type.
   125   */
   126  #define OFP_DL_TYPE_ETH2_CUTOFF   0x0600
   127
   128  /* Value of dl_type to indicate that the frame does not include an
   129   * Ethernet type.
   130   */
